officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official OTR DCCFE cadastre and land-conservation directorate pages list title searches and cadastral services.
Official page says cadastral map is maintained and land-map information is available to public; no feature endpoint found.
Official DCCFE integrated system offers dossier tracking, document authenticity checks and fee simulation; no cadastral map layer identified.
OTR report states Greater Lomé had 2,783 cadastral map sheets, 534 scanned for the 2018 fiscal survey.
Government news reports OTR intended to launch a Grand Lomé GIS on top of parcel data; the report is not proof the viewer remains online.
